code.hf_license: unverified (no license tag returned by HF API)

operator.token: v_i=[d_i^L; d_i^T; r_i^L; r_i^T], d_i^m=LN(zhat^m_{i,H}-z_g^m) (192-d each), r_i^m=(rank_A(c_i^m)-1)/(K-1); 386 inputs
operator.net: 386->64 encoder (LayerNorm, GELU), two pre-norm Transformer layers, 4 heads, FF 128, dropout 0, no candidate-order positional encoding; head 64->8->1 zero-init
operator.correction: delta_i=eps tanh(W_up tanh(W_down h_i)), s_i=b_i+delta_i, eps=0.2
operator.bounded_means: |delta_i|<=eps; preferences across base gaps >2eps preserved; selection only within 2eps of base minimum (Prop 2, Cor 1)
operator.permutation_equivariant_means: no candidate-order positional encodings; permuting input candidates permutes outputs (App B.1)
operator.K: candidate count; 63 on PushT (expert excluded); 17 RoboTwin (1 native + 16 variants); 32 Drive-JEPA

djepa.loss: L_R=-log sum_{i:y_i=1} p_i + lambda_local L_local + lambda_trust K^-1 sum delta_i^2; p_i=softmax(-s_i/T); T=0.05, margin 0.02, local weight 0.25, trust 0.1, subset k=16
djepa.training: 1,000 AdamW updates, 8 starts/batch, lr 3e-4, wd 1e-4, clip 1.0; checkpoint+gate on 64-start calibration subset; fitting-start count for relational PushT: unverified (plasticity path: 384 fitting, 128 calibration)
